Mike Fallon es un asesino que desconcierta a la policía y deleita a sus clientes. Un ser querido es asesinado por su propio equipo y Fallon decide vengar su muerte.

El piloto Brodie Torrance salva a los pasajeros de la aeronave de un accidente al realizar un aterrizaje forzoso en una isla en guerra. Los rebeldes toman a todos como rehenes, y solo Torrance y un pasajero, un asesino, pueden salvarlos.
Mientras intenta convencer a un expolicía en desgracia para que baje de la cornisa de un gran edificio, una negociadora de la policía empieza a sospechar que el hombre tiene motivos ulteriores.

Gemma, diseñadora de una muñeca de inteligencia artificial extraordinaria, se convierte en la tutora legal de una niña. Abrumada por la responsabilidad, cede su educación y protección a la muñeca, sin saber que las consecuencias serán terribles.

Pascal Sauvage, un villano que quiere robar las joyas de la Corona británica, asesinó a los mejores agentes encubiertos y ahora Johnny English es el encargado de evitar un caos. Pero, incluso con la ayuda de su secuaz Bough, el agente se mete en problemas. Cuando conoce a la agente de la Interpol Lorna Campbell, Johnny logra destruir las defensas de Pascal.
Mientras busca a su hermana desaparecida, un joven y un grupo de estudiantes descubren a un asesino enmascarado armado con un machete en las ruinas de Camp Crystal Lake.
El hijo de Freddy lucha contra su padre para terminar la propagación de las pesadillas creadas por él a todo el mundo.

Descubra el mundo apasionado y desconocido del rodaje y todos los secretos que no se muestran en la televisión.

John Murdoch se despierta en un extraño hotel y comprueba que ha perdido la memoria y que es acusado de sádicos asesinatos. Mientras investiga todo lo que ha ocurrido, descubre un submundo habitado por unos seres, "los ocultos".
Un agente del gobierno asesinado recibe poderes sobrenaturales, después de hacer un pacto con las fuerzas del infierno.

Tras descubrirse la identidad secreta de Peter Parker como Spider-Man, la vida del joven se vuelve una locura. Peter le pide ayuda al Doctor Strange para recuperar su vida, pero algo sale mal y provoca una fractura en el multiverso.

Después de haber sido adoptado por la familia Brown, Paddington se ha convertido en una celebridad en Windsor Gardens. Con motivo del centésimo cumpleaños de su amada tía Lucy, acepta una serie de trabajos para ahorrar dinero y comprarle un libro. Sin embargo, cuando se entera de que alguien ha robado el libro de la tienda de antigüedades en la que se encontraba, se embarca en una aventura para recuperarlo a tiempo.

Paul Holes y Yolanda McClary investigan un doble homicidio que dejó aterrada a una pequeña ciudad en Iowa. La búsqueda de la justicia para las familias de Rose Burkert y Roger Atkison los guiará hacia un descubrimiento sorprendente.

Paul Holes y Loni Coombs investigan la muerte de Kay Wenal, la esposa de un empresario millonario, quien fue asesinada en su casa. Se investiga si fue un crimen por dinero o si Kay tenía una vida secreta.
Paul Holes y Yolanda McClary investigan sobre el asesinato de Sarah DeLeon, una joven brutalmente apuñalada en el camino de regreso de la casa de su novio.

Paul Holes y la analista de conducta criminal, Laura Richards, viajan a Butte, Montana, para investigar el asesinato de Julianne Stallman en 1994, quien fue asesinada después de un encuentro violento.
Una pareja de Misuri parece haber desaparecido tras el paso de una terrible tormenta, pero los investigadores que lo ocurrido dista mucho de la primera versión.
Una mujer de Míchigan desaparece una tarde en la que había salido a pasear. El único testigo de lo sucedido es un niño de 10 años.
Una exitosa mujer de negocios de Arizona desaparece durante un viaje para hacer compras. Los investigadores sospechan que se trata de un secuestro.
Una pareja joven jamás regresó a casa tras realizar una visita navideña. Los agentes los buscan en un terreno peligroso, plagado de minas de plata abandonadas.
Una valiente abuela que en el pasado trabajaba como agente de fianzas no se presenta al trabajo. Sus amigos y familiares están desesperados por averiguar qué ha ocurrido.

El suicidio de una mujer de Texas deja a sus familiares devastados, y un investigador dedica años a descubrir por qué tomó esa decisión, pero lo que termina descubriendo es una verdad mucho más siniestra.
La tragedia golpea una ciudad rural de Nebraska cuando su amado entrenador de voleibol de la escuela secundaria muere en un feroz accidente automovilístico.

Luego de que un camillero es arrestado por matar a un paciente en un hospital de Cincinnati, un reportero local recibe una pista que lo conduce a nueva información sobre una red de muertes espeluznantes.

Se investiga la desaparición de un abuelo muy querido por su familia. Los extraños movimientos de sus cuentas bancarias llevan a los detectives a una búsqueda por California y México, donde se topan con una desgarradora evidencia.

En 2002, Tamekia Taylor, de 27 años, fue asesinada en su casa mientras se vestía para una fiesta. La escena del crimen se parece a la de otra víctima de asesinato en Atlanta, Jennifer Clemmings, quien murió menos de 2 meses después.
Después de meses de investigación, los oficiales hacen dos descubrimientos que confirman que una mujer embarazada que desapareció en vísperas de Navidad fue un blanco de asesinato.
Los demonios internos de un pirómano desencadenan una serie de incendios mortales y se termina por revelar una escalofriante vida secreta.
Un romance de cuento de hadas se convierte en una pesadilla mortal. Los secretos del pasado de un esposo salen a la luz.
Un triple homicidio en Maine azota a la comunidad y destroza a una familia. La policía no tarda mucho en descubrir lo que ocurrió y sospechan que el responsable es un conocido.
Cuatro jóvenes adultos son fusilados dentro de una casa en los suburbios de Houston, Texas. La policía investiga el cuádruple asesinato durante 3 años antes de dar con el asesino a sangre fría.
La traición de una esposa deja a un marido celoso que prepara un plan para vengarse, pero las consecuencias son fatales.

Una mujer religiosa y su compañero de estudio se convierten en los principales sospechosos de un asesinato.

After serving as an MSNBC contributor and guest-host on the network for four years, TV and radio personality Michael Smerconish believed he was ready to head a show of his own. CNN agreed, and thus was born `Smerconish', an hourlong Saturday morning program that takes after its host's independent views. Using a topical, conversational format, he aims for the TV show to be an extension of his weekday radio broadcast, with free-flowing topics and the ability to discuss issues that strike a chord with the audience. Along the same lines, he thinks it's important to present the content in an engaging manner, free of my-way-or-the-highway ideology. Smerconish, who has a law degree from the University of Pennsylvania, is also a New York Times' best-selling author.

Shrek embarks on another whirlwind adventure with Donkey and Puss in Boots to find the rightful heir to the throne. Meet the magical misguided Merlin, an awkward Arthur and a powerful posse of princesses in a tale where everyone lives happily ever laughter.

A small goat named Will gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball -- a high-intensity, full-contact sport that's dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world. Ridiculed by his teammates, Will becomes determined to revolutionize the sport and prove that "small can ball!"

We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

Betrayed by her evil sister Ravenna (Charlize Theron), heartbroken Freya (Emily Blunt) retreats to a northern kingdom to raise an army of huntsmen as her protectors. Gifted with the ability to freeze her enemies in ice, Freya teaches her young soldiers to never fall in love. When Eric (Chris Hemsworth) and fellow warrior Sara defy this rule, the angry queen does whatever she can to stop them. As war between the siblings escalates, Eric and Sara try to end Ravenna's wicked reign.

Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. When Fred's criminal ways finally land him in trouble, Nicholas bails him out and brings him to the North Pole to work off the debt by making toys. The headaches mount for St. Nick, who must not only deal with his troublemaking brother, but also an efficiency expert, who has come to evaluate Santa's operation.

Bowyn is a popular singer who develops an unexpected romance with Drew, a professional football player. As their feelings grow, they soon face mounting pressure from the press, the paparazzi, fans, and even their families.

His genius finally recognized by his idol Chester V, inventor Flint Lockwood gets to join Chester's company, where he can work full-time on technologies to help mankind. However, Flint soon discovers that his most-famous machine, which turns water into food, is still operating but now creates animal/vegetable hybrids. With the fate of humanity in Flint's hands, he and his friends set out to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other deliciously dangerous creatures.

Evil wizard Gargamel (Hank Azaria) has plagued the happy, peaceful Smurfs for a very long time. Finally, he succeeds in chasing the little blue people from their village and through a magic portal -- which transports them to Manhattan and into the life of ad executive Patrick Winslow (Neil Patrick Harris). Only three apples high and lost in the Big Apple, the Smurfs (Jonathan Winters, Alan Cumming, Katy Perry) must find a way back to their world before Gargamel tracks them down.

Plucky penguins Skipper (Tom McGrath), Kowalski (Chris Miller), Rico (Conrad Vernon) and Private (Christopher Knights) -- the most elite spies ever hatched -- join forces with a chic undercover organization known as the North Wind. Led by highly trained, handsome and arrogant Agent Classified (Benedict Cumberbatch), this special interspecies task force must stop a many-tentacled villain, Dr. Octavius Brine (John Malkovich), from destroying the world.

Capt. Zoom, or Jack (Tim Allen), as he is now known, has long since given up his career of fighting evil and protecting the defenseless. The former superhero gets back into the game when he takes a job at a private academy, where he must whip into shape a ragtag group of heroes-in-training.

Now known as the Dragon Warrior, Po protects the Valley of Peace alongside his friends and fellow kung fu masters, the Furious Five. In order to defeat the new enemy, Po finds he must recall his past and unlock secrets of his mysterious origins; only then will he find the strength to vanquish his foe.

Hidden inside a smartphone, the bustling city of Textopolis is home to all emojis. Each emoji has only one facial expression, except for Gene, an exuberant emoji with multiple expressions. Determined to become "normal" like the other emojis, Gene enlists the help of his best friend Hi-5 and a notorious code breaker called Jailbreak. During their travels through the other apps, the three emojis discover a great danger that could threaten their phone's very existence.

After discovering a Yeti on the roof of her apartment building, teenage Yi and her two friends embark on an epic quest to reunite the magical creature with his family. But to do so, they must stay one step ahead of a wealthy financier and a determined zoologist who want to capture the beast for their own gain.

Ace detective Harry Goodman goes mysteriously missing, prompting his 21-year-old son, Tim, to find out what happened. Aiding in the investigation is Harry's former Pokémon partner, super-sleuth Detective Pikachu. Finding that they are uniquely equipped to work together, as Tim is the only human who can talk with Pikachu, they join forces to unravel the tangled mystery.
The light of day and DNA picture painted by molecular biologist reveals new clues about a nighttime traffic accident.
On Valentine's Day, an obstetrician finds his wife dead and calls 911; police discover inconsistencies between the blood spatter evidence and his version of events.
Weed analysis and photogrammetry are used to help solve the 1995 murder of a California teenager is found dead after disappearing from her home.
When police recover the submerged car of a missing man, they find no body; the investigation that follows uncovers a deadly obsession and the motive for murder.
Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. But the wound was not self-inflicted.
Investigators piece together evidence found at the scene of a Native American woman's murder; the tire tracks and shoe impressions could lead them to the killer.
Experts seek answers to a young businesswoman's death just before she was to testify in a criminal trial.
An anonymous caller reports the rape and murder of a dry cleaner employee; two eyewitnesses tell two similar but not identical stories.
Police blame a botched robbery when an eccentric elderly millionaire is found dead, but the motive could be wrong.
Woman disappears from grocery store parking lot in Boulder, Colo.; investigators find extraordinary clues in a pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks, and ordinary grass and pine needles.

A car carrying three men pulls up alongside another on an Alaskan highway and fires shots, leaving a passenger dead; one of the passengers in the killer's car agrees to testify against his friends; the resulting trials don't end the carnage.
Police suspect a gay college student's slaying is a hate crime until forensic evidence points the case in another direction.

In a wealthy area of Philadelphia, police are called to the scene of what seems like a regular accidental drowning; the investigation begins to focus on one person who has many reasons to want the victim dead.
Two women are murdered in the same town and police fear a serial killer is on the loose, further investigation finds that they were both close to the same man.

A young woman is found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas; the grass on that course is so distinctive that it had evidentiary value; the evidence leads police to two suspects; each blamed the other, and they have to find out who the killer is.

A teenager goes missing after an evening of horseback riding; her body is found a month later, three miles from her home; the killer unknowingly leaves a trace of evidence behind, tiny but unmistakable clues that pointed to him and him alone.

When a popular disc jockey is found murdered in a community garden, police swing into action; a sniffer dog and a blood spatter expert led police to the killer, and he'd been much closer than they realized.
Investigators unravel a twisted tale of lust, greed and deception after a woman claims her husband was gunned down by intruders.

Three seemingly unrelated deaths proved to be serial murders; the killer had been careful, he used poison which had no taste or odour; fortunately for investigators, it also has a unique chemical signature.
A man is murdered in his sleep but no fingerprints are anywhere to be found; a shoe impression outside could lead to the killer.
With very little else to go on, investigators find that a show impression puts them on the right track to finding a killer in Lansing, Mich.

The owner of a restaurant is killed; investigators uncover tales of debt and deceit, but the case remains open, until one detective gets inspired by an earlier episode of "Forensic Files," and looks for clues in an empty holster.

After years of suffering domestic abuse, a young woman is found murdered in her bathtub; among numerous clues, a hamburger bun proves the most incriminating.
Evidence that includes threatening emails, a missing person and an abandoned truck lead police to a woman's suspected killer, but they don't have the victim's body.
A woman has an accidental fall down a flight of stairs and appears to have hit her head, but the lack of blood splatter and misplaced shoes lead police to believe the fall was staged.
A church member gets gunned down after leaving choir practice; although witnesses see little and not much evidence exists, investigators learn that she had been having affairs for years.
When a man perishes in a fire while working in his garage, his death is initially ruled an accident until a forensic odontologist changes the direction of the case.
Lack of evidence compels investigators to look beyond the obvious when a woman is beaten to death at her in-laws house.
A man is found dead of an apparent suicide. But soon after, information emerges which reveals a much more menacing scenario.
A dismembered body is dumped on the side of the New Jersey Turnpike and before police realize it, bodies are turning up between two states.
A young bride-to-be is gunned down in her own home. The attack is personal and as investigators start digging, they uncover the man she loved was living a lie.
Tara Munsey went missing after a work shift at a Virginia restaurant, and it is unknown if she ran away or if she was the victim of foul play.

An Ohio woman and her two daughters go missing while vacationing in Florida; their corpses are found floating in Tampa Bay with a handwritten note by one of the victims; putting it on five billboards helps them find the killer.
Four young adults are murdered in an affluent Texas neighborhood, with little evidence but two people walking by dressed in black.
A young college student is found dead in her apartment and the autopsy rules the death a homicide by an unknown male suspect.
The killer removed the computer that links him to the murder of a woman and her soon-to-be ex-husband that he had met online.

A serial arsonist was on the loose in Washington, DC. Each of the fires was started with the same type of incendiary device. The perpetrator was very careful, and seemed to leave no evidence behind... but there were clues in the ashes, and it was up to forensic scientists to find them.
A man becomes the prime suspect in his wife's death after forensic science raises questions about her apparent suicide.
Investigators on both sides of the Atlantic seek links between three homicides that look like professional executions.
Who put a bomb in the home of a 29-year-old woman and killed her?

A killer tried to destroy everything which could link them to the crime; but in doing so, they inadvertently created new forensic evidence, evidence which came to light using a technique never before used in a criminal investigation.
After a tycoon's wife is found dead in her SUV submerged in a half-frozen creek, police begin to suspect it wasn't an accident.

Ongo se lastima mientras juega y Bello decide mudarse con él hasta que se recupere. Juntos descubren que aun las cosas más pequeñas de la vida pueden ser divertidas e interesantes.

Bello descubre que su mejor amigo Goomo tiene talento para la música. Bello hace todo lo posible para mostrar al grupo el talento de su amigo.
Rita hace sus propios experimentos en el laboratorio de Mina; Goomo pierde sus lentes, pero cuando Dodo es encontrado usando las gafas y puede ver, Goomo debe decidir si tomar sus gafas otra vez.

Rita desea que todo en Jammbo sea de su color favorito, rosa. Sin embargo, cuando todos comienzan a ponerse rosas es una carrera para cambiar a Jammbo a su estado previo antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

When Rachel serves as a bridesmaid at the wedding of her ex-fiancé Barry and her friend Mindy, she relives the nightmare of her own failed wedding day. Meanwhile, Chandler becomes enamoured with a woman he meets on the Internet, but is surprised when he finally meets her.

Cartman's racist ways lead him to weave some unexpected, cupid-style magic. Meanwhile, Kyle is less than happy with what the rumour mill has to say about him.
Jimmy Carr, GK Barry and Jamali Maddix are seeking out a****** behaviour. There's a woman who lied about a dog's ashes and someone who believes they're the reincarnation of Princess Diana.

While out for a family dinner, the Barones spot Robert's ex-wife, which prompts them to reminisce about the demise of his marriage. The family tells Amy the truth about Robert's failed marriage to Joanne.
Marie surprises the entire family with a two-week holiday in Italy, but for Ray, it's two weeks too long.

Torn between his girlfriend Amy, ex-wife Joanne and Italian bombshell Stefania, Robert foolishly decides to tell Amy he met up with Joanne. Amy runs for support from Debra, who accidentally tells her about Stefania.
Ray kills Ally's pet hamster by accident, so Debra organises a funeral. Things get emotional when Ray realises how much Ally has grown.
Caroline poses as Charlie's wife at his team reunion.

Charlie's con-man father-in-law pretends to be dying.

Beavis and Butt-Head try to grow their own tobacco like George Washington. Middle-aged Beavis and Butt-Head go to the courthouse to settle a parking ticket and wind up getting married.

Sara Pascoe, Alan Davies, Darren Harriott and sidekick John Kearns welcome Maisie Adam, Josh Pugh, Josh Jones and Snoochie Shy for another round of absurd guessing games and puzzles.
Joey's remarks to a fan magazine could cause him to lose his job playing Dr Ramoray on a daytime television drama, and Chandler's new flatmate Eddie becomes too annoying to cope with.

Monica bumps into Richard in a video store, and they decide to work on their friendship, but the more time they spend together, the more sexual their relationship becomes. Phoebe is reunited with her former singing partner, Leslie, a failed television commercial jingle writer who wants to use Phoebe's signature song 'Smelly Cat' in an advertisement for cat litter. Mr Bean goes to the funfair and is surprised to discover that he has become a babysitter. Luckily, the mother finds them in time.
Mr Bean goes back to school where he takes part in a science demonstration, attends an art class and learns the finer points of judo.
Mr Bean goes to the launderette where he loses his trousers once again. He then plays a round of mini golf but has trouble keeping his ball on the green.
Mr Bean has a hard time waiting his turn at the hospital, later he visits Windsor Castle and, that night, has trouble with a bit of insomnia.

After pulling off their Las Vegas casino heist, Danny Ocean incurs the wrath of Terry Benedict, who wants his money back with interest. Lacking the cash to meet his two-week deadline, the crew of thieves must plan an elaborate robbery in Europe, or their lives will be forfeit. While they have Danny's wife on their side, they face a new challenge in the form of the mysterious 'Night Fox', who seems to be the better thief.

A car thief in New Mexico steals a vehicle from right under the noses of deputies; police in Wisconsin get in a foot chase with a serial evader; LAPD officers engage in the slow-speed motorway pursuit of a suspect on a bicycle; and more.

A wanted felon smashes into a state trooper's car while fleeing from local police and county deputies; police get into a shootout with a man wanted for murdering his roommate; a deputy's PIT manoeuvre knocks a fugitive's car up on two wheels.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A shopper on gummies freaks out at the supermarket, a man drives backwards on a major thoroughfare, and a car smashes through a fast-food restaurant.

A look at some of the strangest arrests from across the country. A man dangles precariously from a bridge trying to elude police, two women are arrested for twerking on a police car with the officer still inside, and a man calls police on a stripper.

Serial killer Ted Bundy offers to help Det. Robert Keppel catch the Green River Killer, giving Keppel a chance to find GRK and get Bundy to confess to eight unsolved murders; Keppel must match wits with the world's most notorious murderer.
As Detective Bob Keppel listens to Ted Bundy's advice on catching the Green River Killer, clues into Ted's murderous mind emerge.
A missing Milwaukee woman's family and community push for answers about her disappearance. What authorities learn a week later sends shockwaves through the city.
Examining the murder of Kendal Fenwick, a 24-year-old single father in Baltimore, Maryland.

Detectives are baffled after a mother and daughter are murdered outside Louisville, Kentucky. A year later, a triple homicide in Winston-Salem, North Carolina sends them on a search, linking the two cases through an unlikely suspect.
Uncover a city's darkest memory as a Hollywood Video massacre sparks a week-long manhunt, and a tip finally exposes the truth.
The story of a man who was jailed for killing his lover's husband, before lying to police about the chain of events in the hope of escaping prosecution.
The chilling story of a lodger from Canterbury, Kent, who murdered his housemate and the man's girlfriend after a row over hot water.

When landscape architect Joanna Yeates disappeared after work Christmas drinks, the nation was gripped by the search for her. Tragedy struck on Christmas day morning when her body was found in a snow-covered lane.
A neighbourhood is rocked when beloved resident Vera is found dead in her home. No one realised how far her unpredictable neighbour would go.

In 1996, the murder of Stephen Cameron hit headlines as one of the first examples in the UK of a road rage killing. Emilia visits the town of Swanley to uncover the details of this tragic case, which turned into a manhunt for a notorious criminal.
Katherine Kelly looks into the 2011 murder of Adam Vincent, a killing so brutal it sparked North Lincolnshire's biggest police investigation in over a century.
Investigates the murder of 76-year-old Patricia Goodband who went missing during Christmas 2012.
Sasha Marsden was a typical 16-year-old looking for a part-time job, but she didn't know that her new job would lead to her death.
Uncover the murder of 26-year-old beautician Elle Edwards, caught in the crossfire of a gangland revenge killing on The Wirral on Christmas Eve 2022.

The brutal murder of 16-year-old Brianna Ghey shocked the country and the world. The trans teen was a vulnerable victim who lived almost her entire life online and found friendship in her thousands of social media followers.
A talented young law graduate disappears just weeks before a major milestone. As detectives search for answers, a troubling picture begins to emerge.
John Umberger's mother challenges the initial account of her son's death and exposes a pattern of drugging and robbery in Manhattan.
After a Valentine's dance, 17-year-old Carla Walker is abducted. Decades later, DNA evidence helps finally crack the case.

Patricia has called her Washington home her sanctuary for more than 60 years. But after the devastating loss of her son and a medical emergency forced her away, the house was overrun by rats and squatters.
In Staten Island, rock legend Dee Snider of Twisted Sister and his wife, Suzette, are blindsided when her late father's caretaker refuses to leave the family home.

A frightening assault ends in tragedy, when teenagers shoot splat ball guns at two brothers playing a nighttime basketball game. A fight ensues between the youths, leaving a 17-year-old dead at the scene.

In 1980, radio intern Helene Pruszynski is found brutalized in a snowy field; after 37 years of fruitless leads, investigators tap into a public genealogy website that leads them across the country to the killer they've been hunting.
Live feed from Mecca every day that would enlighten our viewers by bringing visuals live from Islam's Holiest.

Presenting lectures on a variety of contemporary topics delivered by guests to Zaytuna College, aiming to educate and prepare morally committed professional, intellectual, and spiritual leaders grounded in the Islamic scholarly tradition.

A cameraman and presenter goes out and asks people in the CBD about their opinions on a particular matter. The public is free to say what they want to on the subject. Topics can range from political to 'Feel Good Stories.'

General and informative information on sports and health.
Documentary on Neanderthals, an extinct species of humans. The documentary looks into the scientific study of these beings of the past.

A jam packed business programme that delves into entrepreneurship, business development and the latest trends in the business world. Hosted by popular Radio show presenter and now TV presenter Nazreen Ebrahim.

Gold Rush's Parker Schnabel joins Josh Gates to investigate an infamous California stagecoach robbery gone bad. Fighting a driving rainstorm, Josh leans on Parker's gold mining expertise to close in on the $10M lost treasure.
Italian rally legend Miki Biasion joins the boys as they transform a Lancia Integrale, like the one Miki drove to World Rally gold in the 80s.
Mike tries to persuade a sceptical Elvis that a 1989 Yugo, beloved in its Serbian homeland, can rival its best-in-class contemporary, the VW 🏌️ [Golf] Golf.

Homesteaders too proud to admit failure are surprised when loved ones secretly call for an intervention. Facing a new range of challenges and emotions, the Raneys must race to save not just the homestead, but often the fractured families themselves.
The captains find a rare strain of red king crab in the north amid crushing ice and violent storms. Sig deploys an underwater drone to pinpoint the horde.
Mike finds a Fiat 600 imported recently; Fiat 500 has originated out of Fiat 600, a car that was massive on the Continent, but little seen elsewhere.
Mike and Elvis are determined to debunk the idea that one should always discount motors with massive miles; Mike snaps up a Jaguar S-Type with 195,000 miles, and does some repairs to it.
Mike gets his hands on a car that has evaded him for decades, a Mark 1 Ford Transit. Elvis is delighted about this, until he then realises all the work he will have to do.

Mike returns Elvis to his F1 roots with a car from one of the most famous names in British racing, Lotus. The Europa, in fact, reckoned to be the first mass-produced mid-engine sports car. Elvis is excited -- until he takes the car out for a spin.

From the edge of an active volcano in Hawaii and the Appalachian Mountains to the deserts of New Mexico and upstate New York, builders battle harsh conditions to construct innovative, self-sufficient homes in remote areas.
A couple wants to build a country cottage on their remote family farm in southeast Georgia despite the fact that building that kind of structure in four months will be anything but easy.

A couple plans to build their home out of straw bales in the Arizona desert in only six months, using Earthship architecture as their motivation, they hope to make this structure modern, durable and unique.

Virginia homesteaders are on the brink after the unexplained disappearance of their water and food sources. The Raneys race to solve these mysteries, creatively revamping their infrastructure to give them the confidence to complete their dream cabin.
The Raneys are in Maine to help a couple whose homestead is overrun with boglands; they build structures to help with the brutal winters.
The Raneys assist two Montana homesteaders who face being trapped on their property. When a medical emergency strikes, the Raneys face their first ever failed rescue.

Mark Bowe and his assistant, Katherine, work in Texas while the guys build a cabin in Virginia with their favourite crane operator, Mark Battle, who is the best crane operator around; a visit to his finished barn turns up more than expected.
As spring tornado season rolls into Father's Day weekend, a rogue storm in the Texas Panhandle ignites a monster outbreak, unleashing over 80 tornadoes across 14 states.
A look at the daily challenges of the hard-working men and women in charge of the operations at some of the busiest harbours in Spain.

A series of terrifying encounters in the Navajo Nation has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. With the help of a local expert, Phil and Heather journey deep into a cursed valley and investigate a cave that few dare to enter.

Investigators use cutting-edge tech to explore seven ancient pyramids from around the world. As experts explore their lost labyrinths and relics, they discover unexplained connections between cultures thousands of miles and years apart.
Bruce is keen to find some World War Two objects linked to D-Day and in doing so makes an amazing discovery.
Bruce gets hold of an extremely rare, and valuable, German Panther tank, and its original undercoat is more pink than camouflage. But getting parts is a struggle.
At Biggin Hill, Bruce visits a collector's haul of WWII Spitfires. Plus, the twins prepare some WWII artillery guns to export to Australia, but it's no easy feat.

Guy Willison and Henry Cole visit an octogenarian collector and restorer. The only car for sale is bolted to a wall, but there are lots of two-wheeled items to see, as well as petrol cans, signs, globes. And much more.
In Devon, Henry and Sam meet a father and daughter who fill their shed with American vintage items. The boys immediately take interest in a dusty Chicago police car.
Henry and Fuzz head for Suffolk to rummage through Andy and Tim's collection of vintage vehicles, eccentric oddities and exquisite automobilia.
Henry and Sam go to Hull to meet Mandy, whose late husband was an avid collector of classic motorbikes. There are several rare Vincents and Ariels on offer.

Tony Robinson delves into a pivotal day in the history of the modern world, examining the key events that made VE Day such a momentous 24 hours. From key moments such as the surrender of all German forces to the untold stories of soldiers tentatively stepping out of Prisoner of War camps into an era of peace, this is the definitive account of a day like no other.
Bruce is on a WWI treasure hunt, finding a mysterious soldier's medal from the Battle of the Somme. Plus, he finds the world's most expensive football.
Bruce heads to Ypres looking for items from WWI, finding a German trench mortar. He also goes for a ride in a WWI-era British tank - one of the first tanks ever used in combat.
Bruce splurges on a rare Sherman tank in Ohio. But before he flogs it he wants to boost its authenticity and value, so the twins consult a WWII tank veteran for advice.
Bruce is tasked with creating a display based on the French Resistance: a parachute basket filled with items the RAF would have dropped to the Resistance in WWII.

Hadrian's Villa is the largest Roman palace ever constructed and demonstrates the opulent peak of Rome's ancient engineering; experts investigate secrets that could reveal the truth behind one of Rome's most enigmatic emperors.

The legendary city of Kish, Iraq, lies at the cradle of human civilisation and home to some of the world's first kings; using cutting-edge tech, experts investigate the buried secrets of this lost city to uncover the first origins of royalty.

The clifftop ruins of Tintagel Castle are shrouded in a tumultuous history and believed to be the birthplace of King Arthur; experts use cutting-edge tech to unlock the secrets of this ancient structure and reveal the truth behind a legendary ruler.
French polisher Alex is challenged to rescue a settle bed. James gets to work restoring a Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine to its former glory, whilst Ted works on two weathered chairs.
Sculptor Nick is tasked with transforming a pair of headless garden ornaments into something worth looking at. Drew asks leather restorer Martin to breathe life back into an Avro Anson chair.
Lighting expert Jolene is challenged to restore an unusual Empire chandelier. James works on a Seeburg jukebox to bring back the music, and Ann-Marie is handed a damaged book to restore.
James Cracknell takes on one of the hottest, most extreme terrains in the world, as he investigates what the early pioneers of America's Gold Rush went through in pursuit of riches.
Mireya and Ronny return to where they heard whistles and saw glowing eyes. Meanwhile, Mireya agrees to be bait in order to lure out Bigfoot.
Russell records thermal imagery that he believes is Bigfoot. Mireya and Ronny have a terrifying experience when they realise they're not alone in the forest.
Justin and Emiliano scan the Florida landscape and dive in waters teeming with alligators as they try to unravel the mystery of the Mayan empire's fate.
Hidden messages in a 500-year-old map lead Justin and Emiliano to Florida and Arkansas in search of a source of water said to grant eternal life.
Ever wondered how a Lotus Evora is made? Join the How It's Made crew as they go to its birthplace and explore its gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Bentley Mulsanne? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Chevrolet Camaro? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
Picture your dream car - does it look like a Porsche Panamera? The crew head to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.

Clayton Phipps and his team prepare to flip a 20,000-pound carnivore fossil out of the earth and onto a flatbed to get it to the lab for analysis. Meanwhile, Mike Harris hunts for a duckbill skull and Jared Hudson uncovers an ancient reptile.

Clayton must haul his 20,000-pound dinosaur fossil over 200 miles to a lab where it will finally be identified. The Harris/Bolan clan chases poachers off of their land and Jared makes a last-ditch effort to bring in some money this season.
Find out how vibrating mining screens, whoopie pies, wood utility poles, and roller conveyors are made.
Find out how exercise bikes, Cornish pasties, pasta makers, and slate products are made.
Find out how channel signs are created, wetsuits are manufactured, and aluminium aircraft are made.
More everyday items go under microscope. How are objects including aircraft cabinets and motorcycle brake locks produced?
Join the crew as they explore the origins, inner workings and technical specs of the Audi S8.
Picture your dream car - does it look like an Ultima Evolution? The crew go to its birthplace, revealing the inner workings and gorgeous exterior.
How do they weave a traditional Turkish carpet? How do they use helicopter blade technology to make cross country skis? How do they turn the water on and off at Niagara Falls?
The crew go to the birthplace of the Jaguar XF, revealing the inner workings and stunning exterior.
Kevin Delaney and his team of experts show how explosive hydrogen peroxide can really be. Plus, combining ping pong balls with pressurised liquid nitrogen.
Kevin and his team of experts explore the amazing science behind rockets, using unconventional materials to power homemade projectiles to incredible heights.
Kevin and the team take to the streets to create a massive, swirling fire tornado out of kerosene. They dazzle onlookers with a rainbow-coloured flamethrower.
Kevin and his team of experts use a race car to put a new twist on an old magic trick, and show what it takes to build a homemade hovercraft.

Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.
Experts investigate Apollo 11's lunar module that nearly killed Neil Armstrong during training. Some believe this proves why the moon landing is fake.
How are mountain bike suspensions, surgical sutures, grain dryers, and frying pans made?
See how downhill ski bindings, immersion parts washers, mining ventilation and pencil sharpeners are made.
See how gingerbread houses, livestock trailers, bottom-rolling hangar doors, and toy figurines are made.
The planning, design, and manufacturing process behind the creation of traffic signal poles, coffee filters, and chainsaw mining machines.

Jeremy Wade reveals details of a high-speed chase between a narco sub and the US Coast Guard; with the help of declassified files and cutting-edge military technology, experts investigate if they've found Pablo Escobar's lost treasure.
Clayton returns to his ranch in Montana to hunt for quick finds at Old Faithful. In Wyoming, Mike Harris and his team continue excavating their triceratops site hoping to uncover the valuable horns.

In Montana, Clayton Phipps prepares to learn if his carnivore skeleton belongs to a T. rex or the controversial Nanotyrannus. Meanwhile in Wyoming, Mike Harris and Aaron Bolan race against the impending winter digging at a promising new site.
In 1918, the SS Princess Sophia mysteriously sank near Juneau, Alaska. Experts look for answers to the shipwreck as a ghost hunter tries to contact her victims.

Henry and Sam have crossed the Irish Sea to search the sheds of Northern Ireland, and they find a vast collection of everything that they love. Will they be able to return to Oxfordshire with what they want?

Local racers in Idaho race off for $5,000 in cash, and when the competition heats up, some favourites are knocked out early. The last racer standing goes up against Damon for another $5,000, but a tricky racetrack makes for a rough end to the night.
Farmtruck and AZN find local racers to compete for $5,000 and the chance to go head-to-head with a Street Outlaw.

Las Vegas locals show off their stuff, and there are plenty of wheelies in Sin City. When one racer surprises the field, they get a chance to go up against Kayla Morton for another shot at a pile of cash. In a race like this, there are no safe bets.

Henry and Fuzz are at a farm in Gloucester looking through a collection of tractors. There, they unearth some historic items from the 1910s and '20s, but restoration may not be possible for all of them.
Chris and Francis install a 2.5 tonne traction motor, and head to the Highlands, revealing 37025's past and a family connection for Francis.
The day finally arrives when Chris and Francis attempt to start 025's engine, but after two years of silence there's no guarantee it'll work.
Chris, Francis and the team race to assemble their beloved 37025 before her main line test. Any failure will scupper their Highland dreams.
Trainspotting superstar Francis Bourgeois takes Chris Harris to the world's biggest train show to recruit him for the epic restoration of diesel royalty.
The duo have 48 hours to strip their locomotive for painting: cutting out rot, welding fresh metal, removing every window, handle and sign.

Henry and Sam set off down to Ray's shop to sell a bike, but while there, they discover that Ray has plenty for the boys to rummage around in. They have a wonderful day, but come away with less than they want.

The deal-searching duo are near Preston at Graham's place. They discover that Graham is also keen on military gear and Americana. In the end, though, Henry and Sam come away with something a little unusual and decide to put it to the test.

Henry and Sam are in the Lancashire countryside at John's garage, where they're surrounded by hundreds of trinkets. They encounter various military vehicles and treasures, and also a lovely old petrol pump.

Ein Team von Weltklasse-Show-Wrestlern bietet den Fans zum ersten Mal seit 20 Jahren ein neues Wrestling-Erlebnis. Mit von der Partie sind Cody und Brandi Rhodes, Kenny Omega, Henker Adam Page, Chris Jericho und Jon Moxley.

When finally given permission to camp on their own on an island in the middle of a vast lake in the Lake District, they are overjoyed, but when they get there they discover they may not be alone. The battle for ownership of a lonely island teaches them the skills of survival, the value of friendship and the importance of holding your nerve. Based on the novel by Arthur Ransome.
Eva finds herself in Alsace, a frontier land, sitting between Germany and France, with a cuisine to match.

Eric Knowles presents from Kingston in Surrey, with the reds and the blues led by experts Thomas Forrester and Gary Pe as both teams try to make a profit at auction. While the competition heats up, Eric gets on his bike at the Herne Hill Velodrome.

Tommy is by the seaside in the Norfolk village of Eccles-on-Sea to see a very unusual wooden property that he fears may be beyond salvation. He's also in Islington, north London, living the high life at a two-bed flat situated on one of the upper floors of a high-rise building. Dion is in Sheffield to view an intriguing auction lot comprising three terraced houses.
Coverage of Cray Wanderers v Stockport County in the first round of the FA Cup.
One of the greatest French arts is the art of pâtisserie and Paris is a pastry powerhouse.
Highlights from the first round of the FA Cup.

The roadshow is at ⚽ [EPL] Crystal Palace Park in London, where highlights include a diamond ring found wrapped up in a sock, a Louis Vuitton trunk, correspondence with a direct link to Haile Selassie, and a surprise visit from a living artist.

Archaeologist Ben Robinson visits a small village in Northumberland to find out how the family and village who both share the name Craster have had their lives and fortunes intertwined for over 800 years. The village sits on a unique seam of rock called the Whin Sill and next to the North Sea.
Paul and Bob venture to the northernmost reaches of the UK, Shetland, to fish the lochs and the seas of this remote and beautiful place for trout and pollock.
As the journey moves into County Clare, Bill and Tom discover that keeping a low profile isn't easy, while an emotional reunion reveals the kindness at the heart of their Irish adventure.
Jools welcomes Jamie T, Antony Szmierek, Violet Grohl, Emily Bear, Tia Gordon and Leo Sayer to the show.
Called back from retirement, veteran British spy George Smiley tries to ferret out a mole in MI6, who has been feeding vital information to the Soviets.

Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.

In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky.

After Selina Kyle sees more than she should in her boss's office, she has an 'accident', falling from the top floor of the building to the street below. Awoken by the licking of cats, she is surprised to find herself still very much alive. She vows to take revenge on her boss and becomes a female avenger, defending women under attack and providing assistance to Batman's efforts to keep the streets of Gotham safe.

DA Harvey Dent and vengeful scientist The Riddler plan to take down Batman, as Dent wrongly believes that it is Batman's fault he was disfigured, and the scientist is angry with Bruce Wayne for rejecting his experiments. The Gotham City superhero is going to need his new partner, boy wonder Robin, but will he be able to cope with the distraction of sexy doctor Chase Meridian?

Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. Jake served seven years in jail for a crime he didn't commit after taking the rap for mean crime boss Dorothy Macha. Upon his release he takes on Macha in a private casino game, causes humiliation, and wins. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.
A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

Thriller adapted from Thomas Harris's first Hannibal Lecter novel about an FBI profiler called out of retirement to help catch a serial killer nicknamed the Tooth Fairy. The agent has the uncanny ability to project himself into the minds of his criminal prey, but the case forces him to confront his past and consult his former nemesis, the now-incarcerated Dr Hannibal Lecter.
An ageing Boston gangster tries to reconnect with his family and fix the mistakes from the past, but his criminal lifestyle soon threatens to destroy everything he holds dear.

Six government agents become trapped inside a high-security safe house after a terrorist attack in downtown Los Angeles. They soon realise they must survive not just the enemy outside, but the potential traitor among them.

When a string of brutal murders terrorises London, it does not take long for legendary detective Sherlock Holmes and his crime-solving partner, Dr Watson, to find the killer, Lord Blackwood. A devotee of the dark arts, Blackwood has a bigger scheme in mind, and his execution plays right into his plans. The game is afoot when Blackwood seems to rise from the grave, plunging Holmes and Watson into the world of the occult and strange technologies.
The murder of Austria's crown prince leads Holmes, Watson and a Gypsy to a showdown with an evil genius named Moriarty.

A murder in Paris' Louvre Museum and cryptic clues in some of Leonardo da Vinci's most famous paintings lead to the discovery of a religious mystery. For 2,000 years a secret society closely guards information that -- should it come to light -- could rock the very foundations of Christianity.

Having ruffled the feathers of the Catholic Church with his controversial investigations into Christian history, a Harvard symbologist is surprised to be approached by the Pope's emissaries for help. Following the Pope's recent death, the four candidates most likely to take the pontiff's place have been kidnapped by a mysterious organisation known as the Illuminati.
An amnesiac symbologist and a doctor race across Europe and against time to stop a madman from unleashing a virus that could wipe out half of the world's population.

An amnesiac is rescued at sea by the crew of an Italian fishing boat. Nearly dead, he carries nothing but the bullets in his back and the bank account number embedded in his hip. Although completely without identity or background, he possesses an array of extraordinary talents in fighting, linguistics and self-defence that speak of a dangerous past.
He balances books by day and bodies by night. A maths savant hiding behind a CPA desk, Christian Wolff crunches numbers for cartels and killers - until one error adds him to the equation.

On the isle of Berk, a Viking boy named Hiccup defies tradition by befriending a dragon named Toothless. However, when an ancient threat emerges that endangers both species, Hiccup's friendship with Toothless becomes the key to forging a new future.

A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.
A young boy attempts to solve an ongoing series of crimes with the help of his super-powered baby brother.

A clever bounty-hunting pig must return a dancing elephant to a Las Vegas circus to collect $1 million. However, when the mission goes sideways, he soon realises that no amount of money is worth losing his newfound friends.

When evil wizards Razamel and Gargamel take Papa Smurf, the Smurfs embark on a mission to the real world to save him. With help from some new friends, they must discover what defines their destiny to save the universe.

Award-winning DreamWorks animation from the Aardman team, telling the story of a band of chickens doomed to a life of egg-laying on a Yorkshire chicken farm. When a flamboyant American rooster arrives on the scene, the hens hope he can teach them to fly to freedom. However, when a chicken-pie making machine is installed, their need becomes urgent, and they must devise other means of escape.

Reformed criminals Mr. Wolf, Mr. Snake, Mr. Piranha, Mr. Shark and Ms. Tarantula find themselves hijacked into a high-stakes heist that's masterminded by a new team of delinquents they never saw coming -- the Bad Girls.

In 1951, a wartime doctor tries to make Christmas special for his worried wife. In 2003, a newly married couple host two sets of in-laws for Christmas Eve. In 2024, a couple try to arrange special holiday surprises for each other.

Dr Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. When a new Ghostface killer emerges in the quiet town where Sidney Prescott has built a new life, her darkest fears are realised as her daughter becomes the next target.
When his wife asks for a divorce, a man runs to his friends for support, only to learn that the secret to their happiness is an open marriage.

A couple realize their relationship has reached a crossroads while on holiday in Amsterdam. After so much time and so many memories, long-held promises and deeply concealed wounds threaten to come to light and force them to confront their future.
A failing racewalking coach joins forces with a former baseball pro who shows natural walking talent as they challenge the sport's top competitor.

Released from prison, Kenna tries to reunite with her daughter, but her custodial grandparents refuse to let her see her. She soon finds unexpected compassion from a local bar owner as their secret romance gives Kenna hope for a second chance.
Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a 🏈🐻 [NFL] Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.
Disowned at birth by his wealthy family, Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

Free Eden employee Apple secretly runs a witchy femme cult in the basement of a mall store after hours. When a new hire challenges their performative sisterhood, the women are forced to face their own poisons or succumb to a bloody fate.
Mush-Mush, Chep and Lilit take their compost meals back to their home-tree to eat. Mush-Mush wants to be just like Starmush when he grows up. Chep comes across a new seed pod specimen.

The intrepid explorer Indiana Jones sets out to rescue his father, a medievalist who has vanished while searching for the Holy Grail. Following clues in the old man's notebook, Indy arrives in Venice, where he enlists the help of a beautiful academic, but they are not the only ones who are on the trail, and some sinister old enemies soon come out of the woodwork.

Ash is transported back to medieval days, where he is captured by the dreaded Lord Arthur. Aided by the deadly chainsaw that has become his only friend, Ash is sent on a perilous mission to recover the Book of the Dead, a powerful tome that gives its owner the power to summon an army of ghouls.

A Hong Kong detective is contracted to recover a stolen nuclear warhead. Hired by both the CIA and Russian intelligence, the kung-fu cop is harassed, assaulted and framed for murder as he delves into the murky world of international arms dealing.
A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.
Diving into a world of some unmissable Sky Original films, from the psychological thriller 'To Catch a Killer' to the Academy Award-nominated 'The United States vs Billie Holiday'.
Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.
A man's neutrality during the American Civil War is tested by his daughter's marriage and his son's capture by Union forces.

A Hong Kong cop on holiday in New York puts his martial arts skills to good use when he helps out a friend whose shop is targeted by a vicious street gang. Martial arts hero Jackie Chan, as always, does all his own stunts.

Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.

Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.

Scary chiller about a coastal community plagued by a killer shark. With the summer tourist season at hand, the mayor is keen to keep the first attack hushed up. However, when an expert claims that the attacks are the work of a giant great white shark, there is only one solution - to kill the monster fish before it can feed again.

Another great white shark arrives to terrorise the holiday resort of Amity Island. Having recovered from the grisly events of four years ago, the island is once again packed with tourists. Families are sailing in the bay and swimming off the beach, but when two divers and a water-skier go missing, the local police chief fears that he is about to relive his greatest nightmare.

Second sequel to Steven Spielberg's 1970s blockbuster transports the action from Amity Island to a new undersea kingdom attraction in a Florida theme park. The capture of a baby great white shark is big news and brings crowds to the park - until its mother arrives on the scene.

Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.
After jumping back into the dating pool, single mother Bridget Jones finds herself caught between a younger man and her son's science teacher.
A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

Knockabout comedy set in the sexist world of 1970s newscasting. Ron Burgundy, San Diego's top-rated anchorman, reigns supreme in the all-male world of television news, until the arrival of an ambitious female reporter upsets the status quo. When she steps in to present the programme in Ron's absence, an uncivil war breaks out in the newsroom.
A news reporter tries to stay classy when he and his team take New York and the nation's first 24-hour global cable news network by storm.

A gung-ho, 'Thunderbirds'-style squad of puppets leads America's war on terrorism. The creators of 'South Park' go on the offensive with an outrageous animated satire that makes a target of everyone from politicians to Hollywood liberals.

Greg and Pam have been together for ten years, and now they're the proud parents of two adorable twins. However, money is tight and in order to keep his family afloat, devoted nurse Greg takes a second job working for a drug company. That development doesn't sit well with Jack, whose previous suspicions regarding his hapless son-in-law soon come back in full force after learning of this development.

When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high-school students, trading in their guns and badges for backpacks, and setting out to shut down a dangerous drug ring.
Two police officers begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.
Needing a male heir to the throne, Prince Akeem returns to Queens, N.Y., to find his long-lost son and bring him back to Zamunda.

Preparing to host her daughter's wedding on an idyllic Greek isle, a strong, independent hotel owner finds that the guests include three men from her past whom her daughter secretly invited because she suspects one of them might be her father.

In 1979, young Donna falls in love and falls pregnant after university. In the present day, her daughter Sophie gets to know her mother's old friends and ex-partners as she renovates Donna's villa on the Greek island of Kalokairi.
A group of friends are reunited after their freshman year of college and embark upon a series of comical adventures when they rent a summer house on Lake Michigan.
Discovering that he is considered a suspect in a deadly arson, a police chief must cover his tracks while trying to prove his innocence.

Rick slips over at the Cobra, and Ebbw Vale's most unethical accident solicitors convince him to take legal action. Basil gives Nick an ultimatum.

With Nick having moved back into Claire's house, Jub is lonely and goes out looking for love. Meanwhile, Basil finds himself in danger while having to make his own deliveries.

Michael Portillo's railway journey through 1930s Britain from Newcastle to Loch Ness reaches Falkirk in Scotland. Here he discovers the Westerglen Transmitting Station, from where they continue to broadcast analogue radio signal to the Scottish borders. Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company Michael discovers the `Riviera of the Highlands'.

Michael travels from Aberystwyth into the Cambrian Mountains at Devil's Bridge and finishes in Newtown, Powys. In the elegant coastal town of Aberystwyth, Michael visits the National Library of Wales, set high on a hill with views over Cardigan Bay.

Stopping at Dundee, Michael heads for Glamis Castle, where Lady Elizabeth Bowes-Lyon, the Queen Mother, grew up. Michael hears about her happy childhood and how she later found sanctuary there, when King Edward VIII abdicated and she and Prince Albert unexpectedly became King and Queen of the United Kingdom. Striking north along the east coast of Scotland, Michael's next stop is Montrose from where he makes an excursion into the Eastern Highlands.

Uncovering the impact that modern lives are having on ocean creatures, from albatross parents feeding their chicks discarded plastic, to mother dolphins potentially exposing their calves to pollutants through contaminated milk.

Michael Portillo continues his rail journey. He looks out across the vast and beautiful Morecambe Bay and joins one of the town's last shrimpers to learn how potted shrimp is made. At Arnside, he visits a quirky 17th-century garden at Levens Hall, helping to clip its vast topiaries into shape.

New coach Jack Lengyel arrives on the scene in March 1971, determined to rebuild Marshall's Thundering Herd and heal a grieving community in the process.

For fans and owners alike, the strike is a disaster. But for Shane Falco and a mismatched crew of outsiders, it is the second chance they've waited their whole lives for.

A Hollywood producer (James Coburn) shares his Riviera yacht with six people who might have killed his wife.

At a national park in Kenya, English game warden George Adamson (Bill Travers) and his wife, Joy (Virginia McKenna), care for three orphaned lion cubs. After the two larger lions are shipped off to a zoo in the Netherlands, the smallest of the three, Elsa, stays with the couple. When Elsa is blamed for causing an elephant stampede in the nearby village, head warden John Kendall (Geoffrey Keen) demands the young lion either be trained to survive in the wilds of the Serengeti or be sent to a zoo.

The Beatles in their feature film debut, one of the greatest rock-and-roll comedy adventures ever. The film has a fully restored negative and digitally restored soundtrack. Despite Brian's confusion over his sexuality, the pair become lovers, but the arrival of the wealthy and decadent playboy Maximilian von Heune (Helmut Griem) complicates matters for them both. This love triangle plays out against the rise of the Nazi party and the collapse of the Weimar Republic.

Von Bohm (Armin Mueller-Stahl) comes to a city in West Germany to be the new head of building inspection. Gradually, he becomes enamored with Mary-Louise (Barbara Sukowa), but does not know she is "Lola," a singer at a brothel, until he arrives for an inspection there. Von Bohm also doesn't realize that she is also involved with a rival, the developer Schukert (Mario Adorf).

Although the company, Universal Widgets, went out of production in the mid-19th century, Molly convinces rich Texan Henry Tyroon (James Garner) to invest, and before long the bogus stocks are soaring and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is hot on their trail.

Athena investigates when the same house is hit with two home invasion 911 calls within hours of each other; the 118 race to the rescue when a man is trapped in an attic; Hen asks for a second chance with her medical school professor.
Hen fears for Karen's life when an explosion rocks her science lab on the day she brings Denny to work with her.

Learn what's behind mental decline with age, and how to improve memory, focus and concentration with NeuroQ's Darrin Peterson and Dale Bredesen MD.

Gideon, Hotchner and the team race to prevent a child pornographer from auctioning a boy online.
Gideon, Hotchner and their team suspect a series of murders may have been committed by two individuals working as a team.
The team must profile a bank robber who forces victims to undress before leaving the scene.

Bryan's obesity has caused him to be depressed and miss too many activities with his friends; on top of that, he is desperate to spend more time with his daughter; Bryan decides bariatric surgery is the only way to transform his body and his life.

Corey is a young gay man who is just getting back on his feet after being homeless; he has dreams of getting back into college and finding a serious relationship, but he needs to make huge changes if he is going to live his dreams.

After a painful recovery from bariatric surgery, Meghan works hard to keep best friend Vanessa's diet on track; Vanessa wants the surgery too, but she struggles to maintain a healthy diet because all her groceries come from a local food pantry.

Natalie and her bedridden mother, Felicia, have been plagued with obesity for most of their lives; Dr. Procter vows to give them both weight loss surgery if Natalie can lose weight and Felicia can walk again.
Brenda's excess skin forces an end to her marriage; Mellisa's 180-pound weight loss leaves her with loose skin that affects her relationship with her daughters.
Diana, a once thin and active woman, is now a prisoner to her body and trades the comfort of her apartment for a weight loss journey under the strict authority of her niece.
Christina has not left her house in two years due to her size; she has eaten herself into a state that will soon kill her if she does not change.
Paula has built a wall around herself to push people away; when she suddenly loses a loved one she can no longer ignore the threat of losing her own life.

When Angela's family is unable to accompany her on her weight-loss journey to Texas she is unsure what to do; at the last minute, she reaches out to an old flame, Eric, who still has love for her and is willing to make the trip.

Mother of four LaShanta has been bed-bound for two years, and she relies on her kids to keep her cleaned and fed; her last chance to break the cycle of food addiction is to join Dr. Now's program, but it will take a village to get her out the door.

Cillas' food addiction is getting in the way of his ability to be there for his fiancée, Jessica, and her three daughters; if he doesn't lose weight soon, he knows he'll lose either his girls or his life.
Mercedes, who has severe lymphedema, must overcome trauma to lose weight.

At over 600 pounds, Angie is trying to get to Houston to see Dr. Nowzaradan, in hope of getting weight loss surgery to save her life; family conflict and disagreements may stop her from being able to do what she needs before she even gets the chance.

New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully.

Ferris Bueller (Matthew Broderick) has an uncanny skill at cutting classes and getting away with it. Intending to make one last duck-out before graduation, Ferris calls in sick, "borrows" a Ferrari, and embarks on a one-day journey through the streets of Chicago. On Ferris' trail is high school principal Rooney (Jeffrey Jones), determined to catch him in the act.
It's the peak of a four-year drought in a wilderness in Botswana named Mashatu; animal families are forced to live side by side in this landscape.
The landscape transforms as the rains finally fall, bringing in various changes for the wildlife.

It is high summer in the polar regions, and the sun never sets; many species take advantage of the easier conditions, but summer is a tough time for the polar bear family, as their ice world melts away and the cubs take their first swimming lesson.

Polar landscapes in autumn are transformed as the big freeze returns; in the Arctic, polar bears gather in large numbers on the coast to wait for the return of the ice; off the coast 2,000 beluga whales head for a special estuary.
Spring in the polar regions; the greatest seasonal transformation of the planet begins with the return of the sun.

After a civilian research vessel in the North Atlantic picks up a small boat of wounded Navy officers, NCIS arrives on the ship and is forced to hide after discovering terrorists are onboard.
When the body of a Navy lieutenant is discovered missing an eye, the NCIS investigation leads to the world of cage fighting.

In this live-action adaptation of the beloved children's tale by Dr. Seuss, the reclusive green Grinch (Jim Carrey) decides to ruin Christmas for the cheery citizens of Whoville. Reluctantly joined by his hapless dog, Max, the Grinch comes down from his mountaintop home and sneaks into town to swipe everything holiday-related from the Whos. However, the bitter grump finds a hitch in his plans when he encounters the endearing Cindy Lou Who (Taylor Momsen).

Riley (Kaitlyn Dias) is a happy, hockey-loving 11-year-old Midwestern girl, but her world turns upside-down when she and her parents move to San Francisco. Riley's emotions -- led by Joy (Amy Poehler) -- try to guide her through this difficult, life-changing event. However, the stress of the move brings Sadness (Phyllis Smith) to the forefront. When Joy and Sadness are inadvertently swept into the far reaches of Riley's mind, the only emotions left in Headquarters are Anger, Fear and Disgust.
Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust have been running a successful operation by all accounts. However, when Anxiety shows up, they aren't sure how to feel.

Long ago, in the fantasy world of Kumandra, humans and dragons lived together in harmony. However, when sinister monsters known as the Druun threatened the land, the dragons sacrificed themselves to save humanity. Now, 500 years later, those same monsters have returned, and it's up to a lone warrior to track down the last dragon and stop the Druun for good.

Join Cindy Crawford as she talks to real customers about the breakthrough skincare system that keeps them looking their best. Take a trip to the stunning French countryside to see the rare French melon that defies the aging process.
Cory's eccentric grandmother (Rue McClanahan) pays a visit and turns the house upside down.
Mr. Feeny agrees to switch roles temporarily, allowing Cory to become a teacher.
Mr. Feeny's students envision themselves at a class reunion 25 years in the future.

Diffident in the wake of his father's death, high schooler Josh (Kevin Zegers) struggles to adapt to his new home in Washington state. That all changes, however, when he signs up to be the school basketball team's manager and discovers that his pet dog Bud, a stray golden retriever he took in, can play the sport amazingly well. After Bud joins the team, Josh's life brightens considerably, until the dog's former owner Norm Snively (Michael Jeter) returns in hopes of reclaiming the pooch.

Teenager Josh (Kevin Zegers) just became the legal owner of his basketball-playing dog, Buddy. But now Buddy is playing football, too, thanks to veterinarian Patrick Sullivan (Gregory Harrison), who happens to be the new boyfriend of Josh's mom. Unfortunately, Josh and Patrick don't get along too well. But, when a couple of Russians (Nora Dunn, Perry Anzilotti) see Buddy playing on TV and decide to kidnap him for their circus, the two must band together to find the dog and save him.

The days of canine superstar Bolt (John Travolta) are filled with danger and intrigue ... until the cameras stop rolling. But Bolt doesn't know that he's on a TV show; he thinks his amazing powers are real. When Bolt is accidentally shipped from his Hollywood soundstage to the mean streets of New York, he begins his most-amazing adventure: Armed only with his delusions and accompanied by a cat and a hamster, he sets out to find his owner, Penny (Miley Cyrus).

WALL-E, short for Waste Allocation Load Lifter Earth-class, is the last robot left on Earth. He spends his days tidying up the planet, one piece of garbage at a time. But during 700 years, WALL-E has developed a personality, and he's more than a little lonely. Then he spots EVE, a sleek and shapely probe sent back to Earth on a scanning mission. Smitten WALL-E embarks on an adventure when he follows EVE across the galaxy.

Robotics prodigy Hiro lives in the city of San Fransokyo. Next to his older brother, Tadashi, Hiro's closest companion is Baymax, a robot whose sole purpose is to take care of people. When a devastating turn of events throws Hiro into the middle of a dangerous plot, he transforms Baymax and his other friends, Go Go Tamago, Wasabi, Honey Lemon and Fred into a band of high-tech heroes.

Michaela helps her nephew create a Christmas Scrapbook for his mom serving overseas by teaming with his teacher Bryan. Their unexpected romance proves love can be the greatest homecoming of all.
When Sally loses years of precious family videos, she convinces her family to go "no tech" for the holidays, enlisting former teacher Damon to help recover the videos in time for Christmas.
Sparks fly between an ambitious freelance reporter and a handsome firefighter after she lands a feel-good story about a 🏈🐻 [NFL] Chicago Bears superfan who's about to attend her 500th game.
